title: Talk to Your Robot to Change Its Moves! New LeRobot Release

opening.say: Good morning, and welcome to Mono Radio! It's Sunday morning, November eighth, and here's your news.
opening.show: Good morning, and welcome to Mono Radio! It's Sunday, November 8.

opening.say: We've got five stories today, from robots to open models to a metal three D printer.
opening.show: Five stories today, from robots to a metal 3D printer.

news.label: LeRobot v0.7.0
points: Switch tasks by voice, no stopping
Heavy inference goes to a GPU server
New VLA models and more added
details: Use /subtask to switch tasks, /vqa to ask questions about the camera view, and /autosteer to set goals.
Large action models run on a GPU server, so the robot can focus on its cameras and motor control.
Streaming dataset training and new VLA and World Action Models have also been added.

lines.say: First up, LeRobot from Hugging Face, now at version zero point seven point zero. You can switch tasks and ask questions in plain language without stopping the robot.
lines.show: First up, LeRobot v0.7.0 from Hugging Face.

lines.say: I love that the heavy models can be handed off to a GPU server.
lines.show: Heavy models can be handed off to a GPU server.

link.title: LeRobot v0.7.0: From Terabytes to Prompting Robots
link.description: A Blog post by LeRobot on Hugging Face

news.label: Harness Adapters Released
points: Small LoRA built for each environment
details: They're built with reinforcement learning for each pairing of agent environment and model, such as pi, OpenCode, and Hermes.
Tool calls are checked with safeagents. Targets include LFM2.5-24B-A2B and others.
Early evaluations suggest fewer tool calls while accuracy holds steady or improves.

lines.say: Next, more from Hugging Face. A new method builds a small LoRA adapter for each agent environment.
lines.show: More from Hugging Face: a small LoRA for each environment.

lines.say: It's exciting that it could cut tool calls while keeping accuracy up.
lines.show: It could cut tool calls while keeping accuracy up.

link.title: Harness adapters: Safe RL for efficient agentic development
link.description: A Blog post by harness-hub on Hugging Face

news.label: Open LLMs on Japan-Based GPUs
points: API running on GPUs in Japan
details: Fixstars and FastMetal have launched it. Processing stays in Japan, and input and output data are not stored.
The first model is DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, available through an OpenAI-compatible format.
Prices excluding tax are 48 yen for input and 192 yen for output per million tokens, as of the announcement.

lines.say: Now for some news from Japan. Fixstars has launched an API that runs open-weight LLMs on GPUs located in Japan.
lines.show: Fixstars has launched an API running on GPUs in Japan.

lines.say: It's OpenAI compatible, so you can try it just by changing the endpoint.
lines.show: It's OpenAI compatible, so just change the endpoint.

news.label: GPT-6 Cyber
points: Built to find and verify vulnerabilities
details: It's a vulnerability research model trained to work within authorized boundaries.
That's up from the 32.1% scored by GPT-5.6 Cyber.
OpenAI says it helped find 81 previously unknown, high-severity vulnerabilities and draft candidate fixes.

lines.say: Back overseas, OpenAI has introduced GPT-six Cyber.
lines.show: Back overseas, OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber.

lines.say: It specializes in finding and verifying vulnerabilities, and reportedly uncovered eighty-one previously unknown ones in Firefox.
lines.show: It reportedly found 81 previously unknown Firefox vulnerabilities.

link.title: OpenAI Says New GPT-6 Cyber Model Hunts Flaws Without Crossing the Line
link.description: GPT-6 Cyber scored 48.5% on ExploitGym, found 81 high-severity Firefox flaws and stayed in scope 99.93% of the time in OpenAI’s tests.

news.label: Phase3D Layer-by-Layer Inspection
points: Measures each layer during the build
Dedicated unit designed to be embedded
details: Using structured light, it measures the build surface layer by layer and quantifies changes in the powder bed, plus the position and size of bumps and anomalies.
It has a built-in projector, GPU, and storage, plus four trigger inputs supporting 5 to 24 volts.

lines.say: And finally, some metal three D printing news. Phase three D has announced a device that inspects each layer as it's printed.
lines.show: Finally, metal 3D printing: a layer-by-layer inspection device.

lines.say: Catching problems mid-build instead of after the fact is a really neat idea.
lines.show: Catching problems mid-build is a really neat idea.

link.title: Phase3D Unveils Next-Generation Fringe Inspection for LPBF
link.description: A multi-year development project delivers purpose-built hardware for laser powder bed fusion and a new foundation for deployment at scale

closing.say: Today's highlight is LeRobot. Building robots you can correct with your words is becoming more within reach.
closing.show: Today's highlight is LeRobot. Fixing moves with words is getting closer.
